historical_record.description: The Recreation Commission's secretary reported that a dedication program arranged by the Mayor's Citizens Committee, with an athletic program, would open the floodlighting at North Beach Playground that evening.

The Recreation and Park Commission approved William G. Merchant's preliminary plans for rehabilitating the existing North Beach recreation building and swimming pool, estimated at $150,000, after dropping a larger new recreation center the Community Chest had judged unnecessary.

The Recreation and Park Commission awarded the contract to build the North Beach recreation center and swimming pool to Joseph L. Barnes Construction Co. at $250,589, and promised to budget $87,000 to turn the playground's paved area into a junior baseball diamond.

Mayor George Christopher was to dedicate the new enclosed North Beach swimming pool at North Beach Playground on the afternoon of Wednesday, December 5, as the Recreation and Park Commission's calendar recorded.
